usgs.gnis.historical.name: GNIS Historical Features
usgs.gnis.historical.summary: Places in the Geographic Names Information System that no longer exist: former towns and settlements, mines, forts, post offices, springs and other features recorded from historical maps and documents.
usgs.gnis.historical.attribution: Geographic Names Information System courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map

usgs.htmc.name: USGS Historical Topographic Map Collection
usgs.htmc.summary: Scanned USGS topographic maps up to 2006, roughly 180,000 sheets. Which years exist depends entirely on where you are.
usgs.htmc.attribution: Historical topographic maps courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey

useStatus.restricted: Esri's terms for Wayback and Living Atlas content appear to bar a paid app that is not an Esri customer. Needs Esri's written confirmation.

layers.name: Historical Topo Maps
layers.summary: Scanned USGS topographic maps back to the 1880s. Which years exist depends on where you are.

layers.name: Vanished Places
layers.summary: Named places that no longer exist — ghost towns, old mines, forts and post offices — from the federal place-name register.
